title: Who does better in the 2028 presidential race, Gavin Newsom or J.D. Vance?
resolution_criteria: The answer is whichever of Gavin Newsom and JD Vance wins the 2028 US presidential election. If neither wins, the answer is whoever got further: first a major-party nominee beats a non-nominee, then more electoral votes, then more national convention delegates won in the primaries. If none of these separates them, the question has no answer. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when the race is called.
